howToUse.title: Open Wordtune
howToUse.description: Open Wordtune and start the free writer so you can perfect your English. The page says no credit card is required.

howToUse.title: Paraphrase or switch tone
howToUse.description: Paraphrase a sentence or rewrite it. The suggestions offer multiple rewrites, including a casual or formal tone.

howToUse.title: Correct grammar and clarity
howToUse.description: Correct the grammar, then let clarity do the rest. Clarity enhances sentence structure and the readability of the paragraph.

howToUse.title: Summarize or continue a draft
howToUse.description: Use the summarizer. It condenses long documents or webpages instantly. The writing tool can generate intros, conclusions, and drafts.
